name: Create Season
description: افزودن یک فصل به یک سریال موجود

request_body.synopsis: The story continues with higher stakes
request_body.title: Season 2

how_to_run.curl:
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/admin/seasons" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ADMIN_JWT_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"series_id":1,"season_number":2,"title":"Season 2","synopsis":"The story continues"}'
